notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one basic Forest.
Agatha of the Vile Cauldron has power 2 or greater.
description:
Activate a basic Forest by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Propagator Drone by paying at most {1}{G}, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping the Eldrazi Spawn, untapping the basic Forest.
If needed, activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.
